column1: # examen_glossae.tsv - English glosses for examen's codes, by code NAME (stable).
# Hand-written; pagina_examinis.py joins them with silva's own table.

column2: A name redeclared as a different kind of thing in the same scope.
A struct or union with neither a tag nor a body.
An enum with neither a tag nor a body.
An enumerator's value is not a constant expression.
A type name examen cannot resolve (usually a system header it has no lexicon for): a gap in the tools, never a verdict.
Unparseable declaration specifiers.
Primitive and named types mixed in one declaration (e.g. 'int my_type x').
An invalid combination of primitive specifiers (e.g. 'short long', 'signed float').
An array size that is not a positive constant.
An unparseable declarator.
A declarator of a kind examen does not expect: a gap in the tools.
A type was expected here and something else was found.
Old-style (K&R) parameter declarations: not yet analysed, a named deferral.
A struct that contains itself (directly or through members), so it has no finite size.
The size of an array of incomplete type is needed.
The size of a function type is asked for.
Bit-fields: their layout is a parked feature, not yet analysed.
Wide string literals (L"..."): parked, not yet analysed.
An invalid escape sequence in a string or character literal.
An invalid integer literal.
An undeclared identifier used in an expression.
A typedef name used where a value is required.
A typedef name called as if it were a function.
Unary + or - applied to something that is not arithmetic.
~ applied to something that is not an integer.
* (dereference) applied to something that is not a pointer.
++ or -- on something that is not scalar.
* / or % on operands that are not arithmetic.
Bitwise or modulo operands that are not integers.
Addition of incompatible operands (e.g. two pointers).
Subtraction of incompatible operands.
Shift operands that are not integers.
Comparison of incompatible types.
The two branches of ?: have incompatible types.
Subscript [] on something that is neither array nor pointer.
A call of something that is not a function.
-> on something that is not a pointer to a struct or union.
. on something that is not a struct or union.
Member access into an incomplete struct.
No such member.
Brace elision in an aggregate initializer: parked, not yet analysed.
Assignment between incompatible type classes.
Assignment or comparison between incompatible pointer types.
const or volatile discarded from a pointer target.
A pointer and an integer mixed without a cast.
Assignment to something that is not an lvalue.
Assignment to a const lvalue.
Wrong number of arguments in a call.
return with a value in a void function.
return without a value in a function that returns one.
An if, while or for condition that is not scalar.
A call to an undeclared function (C89 would silently assume 'extern int').
A redeclaration with an incompatible type.
A house macro (from latina.h) expanded inside a foreign header, such as a system header included after latina.h.
An implicit integer conversion that changes sign and loses values: legal C89, but the house flags (-Wsign-conversion -Werror) reject it, so examen names it before the compiler does.
The strict form of the same: sound analysis cannot prove the conversion safe where clang's heuristic stays quiet (v1: a subtraction never shown non-negative).
A TOLERA suppression that absorbs nothing, has no reason, or names an unknown code: suppressions rot, and one that absorbs nothing is a signal.
A comparison between signed and unsigned (the house's -Wsign-compare).
A comparison that is always true or always false (e.g. an unsigned value against zero); compilers stay silent on these inside macros, which is how dead code survived in delineare.
A chorda's bytes used as if NUL-terminated (chorda is never NUL-terminated).

A printf format whose signedness does not match its argument: %u with a signed value prints -1 as 4294967295. clang checks the size but not the sign; '%.*s' with a length is the house idiom and exempt.
A negative sentinel (even through a cast, such as (i32)-1) returned from a function whose return type is unsigned: the fault tcp, tls and biblia were born with.
'unsigned <= 0', which can only mean '== 0'. Dormant: the house idiom for emptiness made it noisy, so it waits for flow analysis to re-arm it; SUBTRACTIO_COMPARATA covers the dangerous case.
A path that falls off the end of a function that should return a value.
Fall-through between switch cases (an open end of a case group).
An unreachable statement.
break or continue outside a loop or switch (closes a gap where clang refused what examen had accepted).
goto to a label that does not exist (closes the same kind of gap).
An implicit narrowing conversion of the same signedness that loses width (one code for three clang sub-warnings).
A variable written but never read.
A parameter never used.
A variable read before it is ever written.
A variable read uninitialized on a particular branch.
A variable possibly read uninitialized (the residual class the analysis cannot settle). Dormant: counted, not reported.
An STML annotation in a comment that is anchored but does not parse.
The same annotation identity (nid) used twice in one file.
An invalid identity in an annotation (a nid must be a 26-character ULID; a ledger reference a prefix of at least 6).
A contract broken: the address of an uninitialized local passed to a parameter declared to accumulate (<contractus modus="accumulat"/> on the prototype), which needs the caller to initialize it.
A stale contract: the function body contradicts its declared contract, or names an unknown parameter or mode.
A missing contract: an in-out parameter with no contract declared.
An unsigned subtraction compared with zero by order: it wraps instead of going negative, so a branch is silently dead or always taken (a real villa bug: a timeout that never fired).
A range contract broken: a value proved to lie outside its declared bounds.

Nominal typed quantities mixed: typedefs marked with <contractus signatum=... differentia=.../> are checked, so two points in time (Momentum) cannot be added, only a duration (Mora) to a point, and kinds cannot cross at a call, a definition or a return.
An identifier of the dangerous reserved classes (__x or _X) coined in house code (C89 7.1.3); referring to system ones is allowed, and file-scope _lowercase is tolerated by decree.
An identifier that is a keyword in a later C standard (C99, C23), so the amalgams would not compile under it; C++ words are deliberately excluded (operator is good Latin).
POSIX symbols used without including postulata_posix.h first.
A Darwin-only symbol used.
An obsolete symbol used.
A file meant to be portable includes a platform-specific header.
A construct from another standard (C99 or GNU): C89 only.
A declaration after a statement in a block (C99); declarations go at the start.
A compiler extension (__attribute__): not C89; tolerate it with a reason if deliberate.
